en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4645 - Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj narrated:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who marries his male slave to his female slave. Should she continue to serve him as she used to, seeing him uncovered or him seeing her in that state?
Imam (as) disliked that and said: "My father (as) prevented me from marrying one of my male servants to my female servant for this very reason."
